S12: Vojdan: "Send messengers at once! I want to marry her."
S02: In the cradle sleeps the little princess, and the king and queen stand beside her, full of happiness.
S03: For the birth a great feast was prepared, and messengers invited the fairies.
S04: But one of the oldest fairies received no invitation and did not appear at the feast.
S05: In the midst of the feast, the doors opened and the old fairy entered with wind and wrath.
S06: Fairy: "When a sunbeam touches the princess, she shall turn into an animal!"
S07: Young fairy: "I will build a tower without doors or windows. There she will be safe."
S08: The young fairy waved her magic wand and raised a tall tower without doors or windows.
S09: The years passed, and Mechta grew into a beautiful and charming maiden within the tower.
S10: Since she could not go out, her portrait was painted to be sent to the neighboring kingdoms.
S11: The portrait reached a wild and noble prince in the neighboring kingdom.
S14: With her came two ladies-in-waiting — one kind, the other envious.
S15: Then the envious lady-in-waiting drew a dagger and slashed the carriage roof.
S16: As soon as a sunbeam touched Mechta's face, she was transformed into a white doe.
S17: The white doe leaped from the carriage and fled into the forest, weaving among the trees.
S18: The kind lady-in-waiting followed Mechta through the forest, calling after her.
S19: Envious lady: "Here I am! Now you will have to marry me!"
S20: But Vojdan did not recognize the beautiful face he had fallen in love with. He was sad.
S21: Vojdan fled the palace and hid in a lodge in the forest.
S22: Meanwhile, the good fairy found the doe and the lady-in-waiting, who were embraced and weeping.
S23: Good fairy: "Mechta shall regain her human form each evening, until the arrow of love strikes her."
S24: Then she showed them a lodge where they could stay — the same lodge where the prince was hiding.
S25: One morning, while hunting, Vojdan noticed a white doe in the forest.
S26: The young man struck the white doe with the arrow of love.
S27: The doe fled, and Vojdan followed it to the lodge.
S28: In the lodge, he discovered that in the room next to his there was a lady-in-waiting.
S29: The lady-in-waiting was binding the arm of a maiden — the same as in the portrait.
S40: And so, love was stronger than any curse.
S32: Mechta, dressed in a radiant wedding gown, danced with Vojdan, full of happiness.
S33: Vojdan gazed at her with love, burning with gratitude.
S34: The good fairy and the kind lady-in-waiting watched from aside, happy for Mechta.
S35: But the envious lady-in-waiting, shamed, fled far from the palace.
S36: And no one saw her again — only the wind and the darkness remained behind her.
S37: The ball continued into the night, with music and light over the whole city.
S38: Mechta and Vojdan stepped onto the balcony, gazing at each other with peace and love.
S39: Mechta: "Now I am free... and I love you."
